PageViewInfoGATrackingID.description: Measurement ID of the GA4 web data stream, like G-XXXXXXXXXX, to add the Google tag to every page. False adds no tag.

PageViewInfoGACredentialsFile.description: Path to the JSON key file of a Google Cloud service account that has the Viewer role on the GA4 property.

PageViewInfoGAPropertyId.description: ID of the GA4 property to read page views from, like 123456789. False keeps PageViewInfo's own backend.

PageViewInfoGAWriteCustomDimensions.description: Send the page ID as the mw_page_id event parameter.

PageViewInfoGAReadCustomDimensions.description: Match pages by the mw_page_id event-scoped custom dimension instead of by the page title, so that counts follow page moves. Register the custom dimension in GA4 first. Matching by title misses older events from pages with {{DISPLAYTITLE:}} and from the main page.
